svg.title: Dragon Database — DragonSlapper sword logo concepts v8
svg.desc: Two black and silver Dragon Database logo concepts: DragonSlapper with the original sword underline, and a variation with a sword-shaped T integrated into Database. Both preserve the selected Swordmaw Hybrid dragon art.
svg.metadata: Logo concept. Original v7 Swordmaw Hybrid dragon and crossed swords reused with unchanged artwork. Source lettering and its graphic adaptations retain CC BY-SA 3.0 licensing. Application code and adopted brand assets have not been changed.

g.title: Dragon Database — Swordslapper Classic
g.desc: The selected Swordmaw Hybrid dragon, wings, DB monogram and crossed swords with a new DragonSlapper Dragon Database wordmark. Both words align to the full width of the original horizontal sword beneath the lettering. Black on silver.
g.metadata: Logo concept. Original v7 Swordmaw Hybrid dragon and crossed swords reused with unchanged artwork. DragonSlapper by Allison James (NAL), copyright 2013, via https://www.fontstruct.com/fontstructions/show/830154/dragonslapper; CC BY-SA 3.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Original font file unchanged; the outlined glyphs included here remain under CC BY-SA 3.0. Source lettering and its graphic adaptations retain CC BY-SA 3.0 licensing. Application code and adopted brand assets have not been changed.

g.title: Dragon Database — DragonSlapper Sword-T
g.desc: The unchanged selected Swordmaw Hybrid dragon, DB monogram, and crossed swords pair with original DragonSlapper lettering. Dragon and Database each retain original uniform glyph proportions and span the existing horizontal underline sword. Only the lowercase t in Database becomes an original medieval sword-shaped T with a diamond pommel, wrapped grip, broad crossguard, stout pointed blade, and pale silver fuller. The Database spelling remains labeled for accessibility.
